declared_at: seed-42 downstream screening, before repeated downstream seeds
reason: Avoid treating a 0.0002-0.0004 miss of the screening recall tolerance as evidence a configuration is settled; repeat to measure its tradeoff, not to accept it.
screen: qualifying selected checkpoint; >=10 additional new hits@10; recall no more than 0.003 below control; NDCG no more than 0.002 below control
selection: same original checkpoint selection for every fit; no reselection
final_acceptance: unchanged: all runs qualify; mean new-hit gain >=10; no mean recall/NDCG loss; paired interval lower bound >0; no promotion
later_review_control: cheap cached-embedding pointwise ranker trained on the same original 50-item slates
pretrained_residual: attach zero-init residual attention to the clean selected production50 control, compare identical 10-epoch fine-tuning at lr0.0001; seed42 screen then repeat paired controls if original screen passes; never load legacy learned ranker weights
depth_factorial: at depth100 and repeat quota50, repeat dot+control, dot+added-ranker-signals and dynamic-MLP+added-ranker-signals for all three seeds; compare with the existing dynamic-MLP+control to separate selection from width and feature routing
pointwise_low_cost_screen: also repeat if qualifying and within5 new hits /0.001 recall /0.001 NDCG of control, to assess cheaper noninferior architecture
fine_tuning_budget_screen: repeat clean fine-tuned controls if they independently pass the original +5-hit screening against fresh controls, even if residual attention fails
